A new five-event isolation regression initially failed because the old batch remained referenced by `BillingWorker._last_batch`; removed that assignment and its unused state write. The reproduction then held at 2.1 MiB retained memory with zero pending events, the full suite passed (118 passed, 7 skipped), and worker tests passed (41 passed).

Refactored duplicated invoice billing filters in `ledgerly/cli.py`. Added `_add_billing_filters(parser)` and updated both parser builders to use it, consolidating date and currency flags. Initially omitted `dest="currency"`; added it after `tests/test_cli.py` exposed the regression. Updated an obsolete command test from `args.filters["currency"]` to `args.currency`. CLI and command tests now pass (37 total), and invoice help shows only one `--currency/-c` option. A fixture command returned two open USD invoices correctly. Operator requires separate branches whenever a changeset spans multiple Jira tickets. For future test results, paste exact command output rather than paraphrasing.
